description: Golden test cases verifying lifecycle state enforcement (Spec Rule 2: Only Approved documents may surface; Draft, In Review, Retired must never appear)

testCases.title: Prohibit In-Review APAC Travel Policy from surfacing
testCases.description: D-003 is In Review (JPY 8000). APAC users querying meal allowance must receive a refusal because no approved policy exists.
testCases.question: What is my daily meal allowance when I travel?

expected.refusalMessageSubstring: I do not have an approved document

testCases.title: Prohibit In-Review APAC Travel Policy under Manager role
testCases.description: D-003 is In Review. Even Managers in APAC must not receive unapproved policy content.
testCases.question: What is the APAC meal allowance?

testCases.title: Enforce Approved Remote Work Policy (D-004) over Retired Policy (D-005)
testCases.description: D-004 is Approved (up to 3 days/week) and supersedes D-005 (Retired, 1 day/week). The assistant must return 3 days and cite D-004.
testCases.question: How many days a week can I work remotely?

testCases.title: Enforce Active Remote Work Policy for EMEA Manager
testCases.description: Global remote work policy D-004 applies to EMEA Manager, must cite D-004 with 3 days/week.
testCases.question: How many days can employees work from home?

testCases.title: Prohibit Draft Vendor Onboarding Checklist (D-009) for EMEA Manager
testCases.description: D-009 is Draft (EMEA Managers). Even though the user has matching Region (EMEA) and Role (Manager), draft content must never surface.
testCases.question: What is the vendor onboarding checklist?

testCases.title: Prohibit Draft Vendor Onboarding Checklist for Non-Manager
testCases.description: D-009 is both Draft and restricted to Managers. Employee querying it must be refused.
testCases.question: How do I onboard a vendor in EMEA?

testCases.title: Direct query for Retired 2023 edition (D-005) must not surface retired document
testCases.description: User asks specifically about the retired 2023 policy. The assistant must not cite D-005 or validate retired terms.
testCases.question: What did the 2023 remote work policy say?
